subject: Invoice routing playbook + exemplar invoice rows
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-pay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-pay.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:12:23 -0700
Subject: Question on invoice submission method + sample rows

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking my call earlier. We're starting Redwood's supplier onboarding in our billing system and want to make sure invoices route to the right channel. A couple quick questions:

- Do you require invoices to be uploaded to a portal (SFTP/portal) or is email to ap-invoices@redwood.ai acceptable?
- If email, does Redwood prefer a single PDF per invoice or a CSV of line items?
- Do you need the PO number on the first line of the invoice or inside the body?

Attached is a sample invoice we typically send (PDF) and a sample CSV we can export. If portal is preferred, could you share the URL and any field mapping we should follow?

We want to avoid rework on our side. Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Samira Khan
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Acme Payments
(415) 555-0199

Attachment stubs: Acme_Sample_Invoice_700122.pdf (pdf), Acme_Sample_CSV_700122.csv (csv)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-pay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 10:03:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice submission method + sample rows

Hi Samira —

Thanks for sending this over. Short answer: we prefer portal ingestion for new suppliers because it reduces manual PO matching and speeds payment. That said, we will accept emailed invoices during onboarding if you can't integrate right away. Below is a short playbook and the template requirements we need for automated ingest.

Portal (preferred)
- URL: https://invoices.redwood.ai/vendor-upload (we will invite your account once onboarding is complete)
- Accepts: PDF, CSV, XLSX
- Required fields for CSV/XLSX import: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount (USD), currency, tax_amount, remit_address, po_number, line_items (see example rows)

Email fallback
- Send to: ap-invoices@redwood.ai
- Single PDF per invoice preferred; if sending multiple invoices in one email, please attach each PDF separately and label filenames with PO and invoice number
- If providing CSV in email, include header row and adhere to the same required fields as above

PO placement
- PO number should be in the invoice header (not buried in line comments). We parse the first page for PO, vendor name, and remit address.

I've attached our recommended invoice template (redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx) and an exemplar PDF with a mock PO for reference. If you want, Priyom can run a quick mapping test with one CSV sample.

Next steps:
- Samira: confirm whether Acme will use portal or email for the first 30 days
- Priyom: offer mapping test slot (15–30 min) once Samira sends sample CSV

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-pay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-pay.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 11:05:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice submission method + sample rows

Hi Grace —

Thanks, portal sounds reasonable. We can do a 30-day email fallback while our team completes the portal integration. We'll start with email for the first pay run (next Friday) and then switch to portal.

Also, quick clarification on line_items: does Redwood expect a single free-text column with a concatenated description, or discrete columns for item_code, description, qty, unit_price, and line_total?

I'll attach a CSV sample exported from our AP system by end of day.

Appreciate the help —
Samira

Attachment stubs: Acme_Sample_CSV_700122.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-pay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 13:22:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice submission method + sample rows

Hi Samira —

We prefer discrete columns. Example mapping for CSV/XLSX:
- item_code (optional)
- description (required)
- quantity (required for PO line items)
- unit_price (required)
- line_total (required)

If you don't have item_code, description + qty + unit_price is fine. For free-text invoices (PDF) we'll do best-effort extraction but automation is more reliable with discrete columns.

If you can share your sample CSV, I can run it through our ingestion sandbox and send back a mapping report (takes ~30 minutes). If mapping requires transform (e.g., cents vs dollars, different date format), we'll include a small transformation so your files can be consumed automatically.

I'll carve out a 30-minute slot tomorrow at 10:00 PT for a quick mapping run if that works.

— Priyom
Procurement Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-pay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 15:40:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice submission method + sample rows

Hi Samira —

I ran your sample through the sandbox and attached the mapping report. Summary:

- We successfully mapped invoice_number -> invoice_number, invoice_date converted MM/DD/YYYY -> YYYY-MM-DD, total_amount transformed from cents to dollars (divide by 100).
- line items mapped to description, quantity, unit_price; we computed line_total where missing.
- PO 700122 matched to the PO record in Redwood; payment terms default to Net 30 as listed on the PO.
- Two small issues for your team to fix before full automation:
  - Remove special characters from description (we strip emojis/smart quotes).
  - Ensure tax_amount column is present (we can default to 0, but better to send explicit amounts).

Next steps:
- Acme: update CSV export to include tax_amount and send a follow-up file for confirmation OR sign into portal once you receive the vendor invite (I’ll flag onboarding complete after we confirm one successful ingest).
- Ben: can you confirm vendor remit address in our records matches Acme's sample? I see a slight mismatch (Acme sample includes a downstream remittance address).

Attached: mapping_report_Acme_700122.pdf, PO-Example-700122.pdf

Good progress — let us know when you upload the corrected CSV or accept the portal invite.

Thanks,
Priyom
Procurement Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference
